description: This file declares functions related to PUSCH Time Domain resource index calculations in a 5G NR scheduler, including functions for obtaining resource indices based on slot, configuration, and distribution scenarios.

classes.name: cell_configuration
classes.description: Forward declaration of cell configuration class used in resource index calculations.

classes.name: search_space_info
classes.description: Forward declaration of search space information struct used for scheduling decisions.

classes.name: pusch_config_common
classes.description: Forward declaration of common PUSCH configuration struct.

methods.name: get_pusch_td_resource_indices
methods.description: Returns a list of applicable PUSCH Time Domain resource indexes based on cell, UE configuration, and slot parameters.

methods.name: get_pusch_td_resource_indices_per_slot
methods.description: Returns a circularly indexed list of PUSCH resource indexes per slot, considering TDD/FDD configurations.

methods.name: get_fairly_distributed_pusch_td_resource_indices
methods.description: Returns a fairly distributed list of PUSCH resource indexes across slots, especially for UL-heavy TDD patterns.
